history.narrative: A wealthy, cohesive Nordic welfare state whose Arctic territory makes it a strategic actor far beyond its size. Firmly Atlanticist and among Ukraine's most generous backers, it now has to defend its sovereignty over Greenland against pressure from its own principal ally.

redLines.description: Any forcible or coerced transfer of sovereignty over Greenland
Armed attack on a NATO member, especially in the Baltic Sea region
Russian sabotage of Baltic undersea infrastructure or drone attacks on Danish territory
